model: Barbarian-2 BMX Tandem Frame and Fork
description:
A Tandem? What!?
Yes! You knew we were going to be crazy enough to do this, and just in time for a Spring Build, we bring you the 26" Barbarian-2 Tandem Frame!
Back in 1978, the iconic photo was taken of Aggie and EK cruising thru the pits on a 20" Torker Tandem. Well, now we have all grown up and while it would be cool to have a 20" tandem... the practicality of the 26" Barbarian-2 Tandem is where it is at.
*Please note - Building a tandem takes some great skill and patience. Please be sure to let your local bike shop help you with the build if you have any questions on how to build it.
New Retro Race Geometry:
Traditional Dual Top Tube Race Frame
3/8" Axle - Double Thick ( 1/4" ) Laser Cut Cro-mo Dropouts
Modern Chainstay Brace
Modern Machined Headtube Rings
Stoker Stem - link to one at Hank and Frank
